title: Reckoner button (v2)
description: Square, flat buttons in medium 14px type that change colour over a slow half-second ease: a sand button that turns merlot, and three for dark surfaces (a hairline outline and a faint tint that both fill with linen, and a solid linen one that turns sand).
notes: outline, tint and light are meant for the primary (merlot) surface
renders an <a> when given href, otherwise a <button>
name: reckoner-v2-button

props.name: href
props.description: a link target; without it the button is a <button>

props.name: variant
props.description:
sand: sand fill that turns primary on hover (light surfaces).
outline / tint / light: for the primary surface: a hairline outline, a faint tint, or a
solid primary-foreground fill.

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 42px (header), md: 46px, lg: 55px with 16px text (next to a form field)
